## Conventional PR Title
Ensure your PR title follows the conventional specification with a required scope:
`<type>(<scope>): <description>` (e.g. `feat(lyrics): add synchronized lyric scrolling`, `fix(ui): correct album art padding`)

---

## Description
<!-- Provide a brief description of what this PR introduces or fixes -->

## Related Issue(s)
<!-- Fixes #123, Closes #456 -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without functionality changes
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: Test suite addition or fix
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or maintenance

## Scope
- [ ] `app`
- [ ] `ui`
- [ ] `api`
- [ ] `auth`
- [ ] `lyrics`
- [ ] `player`
- [ ] `config`
- [ ] `deps`
- [ ] Other: `________`

## Checklist
- [ ] My PR title follows `<type>(<scope>): <description>` format.
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally.
- [ ] My code passes all linter and formatting checks.
- [ ] Any required documentation updates have been made.
